parameters.content:
## Shopify Store Catalog & Pricing Extractor

**Actor:** [Shopify Store Catalog & Pricing Extractor](https://apify.com/nimbryxo-studio/shopify-store-catalog-and-pricing-extractor)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/shopify-store-catalog-and-pricing-extractor.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `storeUrls` (array)
- `startUrls` (array)
- `collectionHandles` (array)
- `productHandles` (array)
- `searchQuery` (string)
- `currency` (string)
- `country` (string)
- `vendor` (string)
- `productType` (string)
- `tag` (string)
- `minPrice` (number)

### Output fields
- `title` (Title)
- `price` (Price)
- `currency` (Currency)
- `compareAtPrice` (Compare at)
- `available` (Available)
- `vendor` (Vendor)
- `productType` (Type)
- `storeUrl` (Store)
- `url` (Product URL)

description: Scrape a Shopify store's products and prices: runs the Shopify Store Catalog & Pricing Extractor Apify Actor, returns title, price, compareAtPrice, available, vendor and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
